reports.title: News to Know: fishing report
reports.text: Catchable-sized bluegill were stocked at Paradise PFA, while largemouth bass and smaller bluegill were transferred to Dawson Fish Hatchery. The bass will be used to establish all-female populations at locations across Georgia for a study comparing growth among largemouth bass genetic strains.

reports.title: Lake Hartwell fishing report
reports.text: Hybrids and Black Bass: (Courtesy of Cole Wilson, Spot Chaser Guide Service ) — Hybrids and bass are schooling up and eating across the lake in preparation for the upcoming lake turnover. Fish points and humps across the lake in 10 to 30 feet of water with a walking bait like the IMA Skimmer in chrome or the Chug Bug, or a chartreuse herring Fluke weightless on top. Watch for schooling fish; they will be easy to catch if you get a bait on them while they are schooling. When the topwater slows, bottom fishing with a Carolina rig or shaky head and a Senko dragged over these points and humps can catch fish, too. Pay attention to the water. If it is dirty, stinky, or smelly, that is a good sign…

reports.title: Lake Allatoona fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie: (Report courtesy of Red Rooster Baits )
Crappie fishing on Lake Allatoona is about to bust loose! The crappie are starting to move around with the lake level dropping and the water temps dipping into the mid to high 60s. We trolled this past week using our newest jig, the “ Hammer Curl ,” which is our take on the traditional curly tail crappie jig, and it did not disappoint! We landed several nice slab crappie with the Hammer Curl in a few different colors that we chose due to water clarity and daylight conditions. We were looking for roaming schools of crappie that were making their way from brush out into open water. The crappie were suspended anywhere from 4′ to 10′ in 8′ to 12′…

reports.title: Big Lazer Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth bass fishing is fair right now. Fish plastic worms in deeper water and around structure. Try fishing these baits slower than normal in the cooler waters. Fishing the timber around the island may produce decent bites. Bream fishing is also just okay this time of year. Spawning is complete, so the bream fishing is beginning to slow some. Live bait such as crickets and worms should give you the best chance to catch a nice bream. Try fishing in woody brush 5-10 ft deep under a cork. Artificial bait such as beetle spins may also be a good choice to entice a bite. For catfish, try fishing chicken liver or shrimp in deeper water near the bottom. Standing timber all over the lake may…

reports.title: Chattahoochee And Flint River fishing report
reports.text: Water temperatures in the rivers are down with the cool nights we have been having, and bass fishing is picking up! Fly fishing on the Flint River targeting shoal bass is a lot of fun and a unique activity specific to southwestern Georgia.

reports.title: Lake Walter F George fishing report
reports.text:
According to Ken Sturdivant at Southern Fishing, bass fishing is fair. The bass are like they were half and half on the shallow stuff and on the ledges.
The cooler weather has the crappie biting as well, with reports of limits mostly being caught on minnows.

reports.title: Lake Seminole fishing report
reports.text:
According to Ken Sturdivant at Southern Fishing, bass fishing has been fair. Suspending bass are located just off main lake or river points in 15 to 20 feet of water.

reports.title: Lake Blackshear fishing report
reports.text: The crappie bite is on fire right now. Anglers are fishing in 11- 18 ft of water and recommend Crappie Mayhem jigs or minnows on slip corks; get the gold ones from Flint River Outdoors, LLC.

reports.title: Urchin or Uni soft plastic baits?
reports.text:
I guess theres alot of hype around Yamamoto Uni baits since some tournaments really took off with the success of these kind of baits.
I have not tried one yet.
Seems like an easy bait to plop under a dock and pull out a big ole lazy Bass.
Please post if you've had any success with these type of spider baits. I'd love to see some reports. They look like some toy from a kids toy vending machine,
